product_overview: Sidra Attar is a premium e-commerce web application for browsing and purchasing high-end fragrances. It supports product discovery, account access, profile management, shopping cart review, and checkout with multiple payment methods.
core_goals: Learn about the brand on the About page
Create an account and sign in with email and password
Manage profile details and upload a profile picture
Complete checkout using supported payment methods
View past orders and current order status

features.name: Product Browsing
features.description: Users can explore fragrances on the home page, collections page, store page, and individual product pages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse the product grid -> Open a product to view its details -> Return to browsing
Navigate to /collections -> Browse available collections -> Open a product to view its details -> Return to browsing
Navigate to /store -> Browse the full store catalog -> Open a product to view its details -> Return to browsing

features.name: About Us Information
features.description: Users can read the brand mission and vision on the About page.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Read the mission and vision content -> Return to browsing

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can sign up and sign in with email and password through the authentication page.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Toggle between sign-in and sign-up mode -> Fill email and password fields -> Submit the form -> See authentication complete
Navigate to /auth -> Fill email and password fields -> Submit the form -> See authentication complete

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Users can review items in the cart before proceeding to purchase.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> Review items in the cart -> Update item quantities -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the updated total

features.name: Account Management
features.description: Authenticated users can manage their profile information, upload a profile picture, and view order history.
user_flows: Navigate to /account -> Upload a profile picture -> Update account information -> See the saved profile changes
Navigate to /account -> View order history -> Open an order entry -> Review order details

features.name: Checkout and Payment
features.description: Authenticated users can enter shipping details, choose a payment method, and complete an order.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Enter shipping details -> Select a payment method -> Complete the transaction -> See order confirmation and status tracking
Navigate to /checkout -> Enter shipping details -> Select cash on delivery -> Complete the transaction -> See order confirmation and status tracking
Navigate to /checkout -> Enter shipping details -> Select UPI payment -> Complete the transaction -> See order confirmation and status tracking
Navigate to /checkout -> Enter shipping details -> Select card payment -> Complete the transaction -> See order confirmation and status tracking
